source: OURS: tools/boss_phases.py (ported from ckrealm/A2Core, AGPL-3.0; the rules are in its docstring). Bosses, skills, cast times and adds are the client's own (map-events.json, world-npcs.json); a slam's area is the client's skill-areas.json shape when it has one (radius_from: skill-areas), else the invented radius (radius_from: OURS). Phase thresholds, intervals, multipliers and the hand-made waves are invented (OURS), except the hard modes' 4-minute frenzy (global's rule). Ludra's waves are the client's own spawn entries.
